Context: (f) At the Same Station-

spouse transferred later will get 50% of composite transfer grant. However, if both the transfers are ordered within 60 days, the second transfer grant of 50% is not admissible. - GIO (1), Para. II (c), SR 116.  
- Family includes-
- (i) Definition of family.-
- (1) Spouse residing with the employee. (Need not be dependent). Only one wife is included in the term 'family'.
